meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位AI不调用工具或卡死循环的根因并修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发AI智能体,且常遇到工具调用出错或卡循环。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix AI agent tool-calling failures and loops.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI agents and often see tool-calling errors or endless loops.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先让你从 4 类症状中选一个，再按对应分支带你诊断 tool-calling 问题；从零做工具时走 5 步 schema 设计法。它指方向和给参考示例，不替你写代码。
howto.when: 当你在做 tool-calling agent 卡住时接管——LLM 不调用你的 tool、参数传错、ReAct loop 跑不停等，或要从零设计 function schema。纯框架、MCP server、生产监控问题会转走。

say.text: 我的 LLM 不调用我写的 tool，帮我看看哪里出问题
say.note: 它会先问你属于 4 类症状里的哪一种

say.text: 帮我设计这个 tool 的 function schema
tool 被调用了，但 arguments 不对

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through a four-branch diagnosis and a five-step schema design walkthrough for tool-calling agents, pointing to bad/good schema examples and an SDK comparison. It diagnoses and points at fixes rather than writing code for you.
howto.when_en: Use when a tool-calling agent fails — the LLM won't call your tool, arguments are wrong, or a ReAct loop won't stop — or when you need a function schema. Not for framework, MCP, or monitoring.

say_en.text: My LLM won't call the tool I wrote — help me diagnose it.
say_en.note: It first asks which of the 4 symptoms you have.

say_en.text: Help me design the function schema for this tool.
The tool gets called but the arguments are wrong.
say_en.note: Checks parameter types, required, and enum.
